about: The launch tour's songs, in play order (his picks, 2026-10-21; guide/SHOTS.md §5k). launch-tour-queue.mjs loads the ids; launch-tour-rules.cjs makes one rule per song from the album (the rules match the album, so it must be Apple's album name exactly). A song with an empty id is skipped, and so is its beat. `stand_in` marks a song he has not picked yet. `caption` is what Deets says in his speech bubble when the song's look lands (his words; the skin's name is the placeholder, 2026-10-21). `end` is his last line; empty = none.
